account_danger_description: Deleting your account removes your profile and sessions. We email you a confirmation link first; nothing is deleted until you use it.
account_delete_check_inbox: Check your inbox to confirm deletion. Open the link in this browser while signed in; your account stays active until then.
account_email_confirm_sent: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to approve the change.
account_email_description: Used to sign in and for account notifications.
account_email_verify_sent: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to finish the change.
account_password_changed_description: Every other device has been signed out.
account_password_description: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else.
account_password_too_short: New password must be at least {minimum} characters.
account_profile_description: How you appear to your teammates.
account_security_2fa_description: Add a second step at sign-in using an authenticator app. Backup codes cover a lost device.
account_security_backup_codes_help: Each code signs you in once if you lose access to your authenticator. Store them somewhere safe — they are only shown now.
account_security_codes_generated_descrip: Your previous codes no longer work.
account_security_copy_failed: Copying failed. Select the codes and copy them manually.
account_security_enter_code: Enter the 6-digit code from your app to finish
account_security_manual_key_unavailable: Manual key unavailable — scan the code instead.
account_security_passkey_remove_descript: You will no longer be able to sign in with this device or security key. Your password and other passkeys keep working.
account_security_passkeys_description: Sign in with your device's screen lock or a security key instead of a password.
account_security_passkeys_empty_descript: Add one below to sign in with your device's screen lock or a security key.
account_security_passkeys_unsupported: Passkeys aren't supported in this browser.
account_security_prompt_disable: Confirm your password to turn off two-factor authentication.
account_security_prompt_enable: Confirm your password to start setting up an authenticator app.
account_security_prompt_regenerate: Confirm your password to generate a new set of backup codes. Existing codes stop working.
account_security_scan_qr: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy…), or enter this key manually:
account_sessions_description: Devices currently signed in to your account. Revoke anything you don't recognise.
account_sessions_empty_description: Sign in again and this device will show up here.
account_sessions_others_signed_out: Every other session has been signed out
account_sessions_revoke_dialog_descripti: That device is signed out immediately and has to sign in again.

match.countPlural=one: {count} other session is signed out immediately. This device stays signed in.
match.countPlural=other: {count} other sessions are signed out immediately. This device stays signed in.
